text: I know it's been a real long time, right? How have you've been? Me, my little brother and mum and dad visited Srinagar during the summer vacation. And let me be very honest, the place was heaven. Beside its dreadful history and all that, that place is the heavenly paradise where every human wants to live. First, we visited the nation-wide famous Dal lake, where we went boating. I really enjoyed the ride on boat which gave me a whole different and amazing feeling. The next day we visited Saffron Field, trust me, that's the most beautiful place I've ever seen. Everybody love flowers. And the field had different varieties of flowers from roses to daisies. And how did I forget Shalimar Bagh?? It is the most lovely place with a very cool climate, there were really a lot to see. There were a lot other places I saw, but these were the best ones out of them all. The trip had surely brought a change in me. I'd love to visit more places like that.
